egress.terms: bandwidth is quoted as a hard multiple of storage — "5 TB Bandwidth @ 10 Gbps" on 1 TB, "40 TB" on 8 TB, "80 TB" on 16 TB. So 5x storage per month. NOT unmetered. A LET poster claims "its actually unmetered if you know how to set it up" — treat that as unverified forum folklore, not a policy.

interface_detail: SSH, FTP, rsync, SFTP, DirectAdmin panel. **No WebDAV, no SMB** — confirmed by LET users comparing it to Hetzner.
tooling: rsync/rclone-over-SFTP only. No S3, no WebDAV, no object API.
chaining: Weakest chaining of the top candidates: no WebDAV means AList mounting requires an SFTP shim, and no S3 means no presigned URLs. Fine as a pure rsync/Borg target behind an app server; poor as a served origin.
limits_note: DirectAdmin is a web-hosting panel bolted onto storage — you manage FTP users and bandwidth there. RAID-6 (DE) / RAID-60 (500 GB) at order-page level. US inventory and DE inventory are separate products with separate coupons.
reliability_note: Real hosting business (labze), 2+ years on LET with a Patron Provider tag; users report multi-year renewals at the same price, which is rare. But it is a small operator reselling/colocating, not owning DCs — and the 500 GB SKU is excluded from BFBOX by design.
